consequence.statement: Promtail now correctly evaluates the excludepath setting on newly added files, fixing incorrect behavior in previous versions where these files were not filtered according to the excludepath rules.

original.statement: Promtail's excludepath configuration is now correctly evaluated on newly added files, fixing a bug where it was previously ignored.

decision.reason: [ev-5660e882c2ce] lists this only as a bug fix: Promtail now evaluates excludepath on newly added files. Nothing there says that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. The only effect is that new files matching excludepath are now excluded, so ingestion behaves differently, which fits behavior-change (review) at low severity. The changelog doesn't describe the operational effect directly, so the kind is inferred, which is why confidence is low.
